Network.Title: Network
Network.Subtitle: Everything that comes in and goes out: live traffic per app, every connection, open ports and the devices in your home network.
Network.NeedsAdmin: Live traffic per app and connection needs administrator rights. Start EZTool as administrator.
Network.TodayNote: All apps since midnight, from the Windows statistics
Network.ActiveNowEmpty: No app is sending or receiving right now.
Network.PublicIpNote: Shows the address the internet sees. EZTool asks api.ipify.org for it once.
Network.AppsNote: Live rates are measured right now. Totals come from the Windows statistics and include all networks.
Network.ConnNote: Which app is talking to which server. Totals count from the moment this page was opened.
Network.PortsNote: Programs that wait for incoming connections. Ports marked "all networks" can be reached from other devices unless the Windows firewall blocks them.
Network.DevicesNote: EZTool pings every address in your home network, reads the MAC addresses and asks your router for the device names. The manufacturer comes from the public IEEE list.
